verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe agent mode editing files across the workspace and proposing and validating edits. They also describe a cloud agent that works autonomously in the background to plan, explore and complete tasks from assigned issues or @copilot PR comments, which covers the plain-language feature/bug-to-implementation flow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of multi-file agent implementations (community evidence mostly covers inline completion), and explicit documentation of cross-file change scope rather than the implied plural 'files'.
